identity_policy.family_rule: A parameterized family keeps its own problem_id. Derived views may relate or group Problems but may not erase an identity.
identity_policy.immutability: A problem_id is never reassigned. Rename, split, merge, and supersession are append-only history events.

inclusion_policy.review_requirement: Every included declaration and its grouping, question basis, source locator, and rights record is reviewed as one registry change.

nonclaims: No verifier output implies Formal Conjectures maintainer acceptance.
No Problem record creates a Vela Claim, Standing, or protocol object.
The profile does not assert that a third-party source grants rights beyond the per-item record.
VibeMathed, TheoremDB, generated Pages, and Vela are not collection authorities.
AI translations, titles, and status guesses are not canonical Problem text or status.
Research-open reports the reviewed Formal Conjectures source assertion at the bound revision, not an independent claim that no solution exists.
question_policy: Human-readable questions are exact normalized docstrings of listed research-open declarations; no generated paraphrase is authoritative.

rights_policy.unknown_third_party_rights: Must be explicit per item; inclusion does not assert permission to retain or redistribute third-party bytes.

status_policy: Open status is an explicit reviewed source assertion with declaration evidence and an exact last-checked Git revision; it is not inferred from a missing proof.
title_policy: A title is either the exact tracked module heading or a reviewed phrase present in a listed declaration docstring.
